parent.AAI11A_result: DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE, loss -0.3640625 vs structural graph_recent8 and 3.166765x/3.800335x whole-process cost; locked, not modified

hypothesis: Learning from actual intervention-induced mediator flips (do-action consequences), not passive state correlations or protected-slot recall, improves causal hypothesis selection under unfamiliar composed laws while using the exact same operator grammar, recent-8 public memory and common planner as strongest existing graph_recent8 control.

mechanism.name: InterventionalContrastTournament
mechanism.operator_grammar: Exactly AAI-11A graph_recent8 45+45+84 XOR/AND/OR hypotheses, no new rules or privileged formulas; reuse original public prediction grammar, original common planner, same recent-eight observed public events.
mechanism.memory: Retain exactly most recent eight public rows plus their actions_taken 0/1/2 markers to link consecutive actual do-action pre/post records; no historical protected slots, extra observations or simulator labels; at most 8 public rows, same length as graph_recent8.
mechanism.static_evidence: For each rule/output use the exact public-output mismatch count over the eight recent observations, as in graph_recent8.
mechanism.interventional_contrast: For each consecutive publicly observed pair where action count advances by 1 (0->1 or 1->2) AND public x actually changes, calculate whether the rule-predicted mediator flip matches the actual publicly observed mediator flip, using for mediator2 the PUBLICLY OBSERVED upstream mediators at each pair endpoint. Add exactly 2 mismatch-equivalent errors for each disagreement. Use only pairs fully present inside current recent-eight window. No action label or hidden counterfactual needed: compare public x and public m.
mechanism.selection: Minimize static_errors + 2 * contrast_flip_errors per mediator with exact original stable operator-index ties. Output 0.9 for MAP predicted 1, 0.1 for MAP predicted 0, composed downstream from model-predicted upstream. Re-evaluate/invalidate after every new actual public observation. No post hoc threshold tuning.
mechanism.planning: Original AAI-11P controls.plan, same 0 to 2 do-action episodes and public stop/ties; zero information-gain exploration bonus. Only intervention evidence changes association learning.
mechanism.cold: Canonical exact checkpoint, old eight public x/m evidence and action-count markers only; derived mismatch/error caches never serialized; no source change to original graph_recent8 or benchmark.
mechanism.ablation: Unmodified AAI-11A graph_recent8 same grammar, same eight public rows, no contrast term; original 11 fully matched controls retain eligibility; optional negative skip contrast within source test only.
mechanism.novelty: Different causal learning signal than failed protected slot memory; source can't import simulator privileged law formulas.

source_development.first_sequential_gate: Evaluate new candidate ONLY, on exactly same 3 frozen mechanical fixtures/contexts and evidence as historical fully qualified AAI-11A graph_recent8. Require candidate reward >=2.214027778 (old strongest 2.134027778 +0.08) and exact 3-goal success >=0.60. A FAILURE ends DEV_NO_GO and prohibits new primary cohorts, any retune, and unnecessary repeat of old 11 controls.
source_development.if_first_pass: Reexecute all 11 original fully trained conventional methods in same exact-source test to confirm strongest baseline, matched A/B retention within -0.03, real whole-process time <=2x fastest matched on both Linux/Windows, and negative causal pairing control, then full final cross-OS regression. No scientific first-use regardless.
source_development.independent_success: Source fixture diagnostics are NOT scientific gain: no 64-world paired CI, no transfer claim, no neural/nontoken general-intelligence claim. Strongest control selected by achieved actual terminal reward.
source_development.cost_if_first_pass: Wallclock train+checkpoint+challenge+actual intervention/restore time, same machine/inputs; avoid comparing timings across separate CI hosts.
source_development.disarm: Reserved new 994000..994015, 995000..995063, 996000..996031 untouched; accept only the three literal mechanical fixture IDs; --primary and all science seeds fail closed.
source_development.equal_data: every model sees its own consequences only, common training/challenge observations and identical action budget; no extra original dataset exposure beyond recent8.

qualification: Frozen prereg-before-code; source-only negative privacy and grammar-parity tests on each OS; source-pinned current G29 atlas; mandatory full exact-head native 54/54 + AAI11P 10/10 + AAI11A 10/10 + AAI11B focused tests both OS (even if dev NO-GO); record failure rather than tune.
